_comment: Copy to bindings.json (git-ignored). Web case id -> the real PayPal sandbox payment it stands for: the dispute id and the capture it is about (npm run demo:prepare prints this). Before anything is sent, the server checks on a fresh read that the dispute is about exactly that capture, for the case's amount and currency. The old form "case": "PP-R-..." (no capture) is still read but cannot pass that check. Unbound cases stay on the simulated PayPal.
_comment_settlement: Owner-only settlement case (the standard case's 7.00 USD order): a list binds the first dispute and keeps the rest in reserve. Only the workspace owner sees it; it is never moved off a dispute an action is still settling.
